items.headline: GTA VI legal and labor issues

sentences.text: KuCoin describes AI-assisted GTA 6 PC ports as prompting a legal crackdown.
GamesRadar reports that Rockstar workers voted against a union recognition deal following GTA 6’s release.
Rockstar Intel reports that GTA VI developers voted against unionization after a battle with Rockstar.
dev.ua reports that fraudsters disguise viruses as GTA VI PC ports on GitHub.
Neowin reports that fake PC ports infect victims with ClickFix malware, while Bitdefender calls the port hype a gift to ClickFix attackers.
The linked article says several private builds play through Lucia’s prologue and reach Jason’s first mission, though they render badly and vehicles often fail.
GamesRadar reports that multiplayer is reportedly running on PC as unofficial ports near completion.
TechRadar says a video shows unofficial multiplayer at 30fps with working voice chat, while PC Guide reports characters, vehicles, and proximity chat.
